$comment: Single source of truth for brand consistency. Every render, caption file, QC check and AI prompt reads from here. Edit this file, not the code.

brand.name: Your Brand
brand.niche: high-protein recipes and fitness meal prep
brand.audience: 25-40, trains 3-5x a week, cooks at home, short on time
brand.promise: Big flavour, real macros, under 30 minutes

voice.tone: confident, warm, no fluff; a knowledgeable friend, not a nutrition lecture
captionRules: sentence case, never all caps for full sentences
hookFormulas: The {{dish}} I eat every training day
{{calories}} kcal and it tastes like this
ctas: Save this for meal prep day
Follow for a new recipe every day
Comment RECIPE and I'll send it

transitions.notes: Hard cuts on the beat by default. Whip only between prep and cook, and between cook and plating. No dissolves, no zoom-blur presets.

colorGrade.notes: Warm, high contrast, saturated oranges and reds, lifted blacks, greens kept natural. Skin stays natural, never orange.

visualStyle.lighting: soft natural window light, warm key from camera left, no on-camera flash
visualStyle.surfaces: dark slate, walnut chopping board, matte black bowls, brushed steel pan
visualStyle.lens: 35mm for overheads and mediums, 85mm macro for close-ups, shallow depth of field
visualStyle.palette: warm neutrals with pops of green herbs and red chilli
visualStyle.props: linen napkin, brass cutlery, cast-iron pan, glass meal-prep containers
visualStyle.avoid: harsh flash, plastic props, glossy stock-photo look, floating ingredients, perfect symmetry, watermarks

thumbnails.layout: hero dish on the right two-thirds, 3-4 word title on the left, macro badge top-left

neverFor: any step that teaches a technique
aiBroll.notes: AI inserts must be indistinguishable in grade and lighting; if it needs a disclaimer, it does not ship.
